title: build save with no terminal and no --yes shows the file, refuses with exit 2 and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut" (build save asks on a terminal or takes --yes): a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK, which is a terminal answer or --yes; the guard denies the agent
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). `jitso build save <id>` shows the build it would write (the draft bytes with `status: approved`) on stdout, every line prefixed with `+ `. Standard input is not a terminal here, and the runner never gives one, so with no `--yes` it refuses: `JITSO REJECTED: saving a build needs the owner: read the file above, then run it again with --yes, or in a terminal to answer the prompt; nothing saved`, exit 2. Nothing is written and the draft is kept.
